description: This file implements the MessageUnit class, which manages message serialization, updating control states, opening and closing message dispatchers, and pushing messages within a messaging framework. It includes nested handler classes for control iteration and manages resources such as directories and dispatchers.

classes.name: MessageUnit
classes.description: Manages messaging operations including serialization, control updates, and resource management within the messaging framework.

classes.name: Handler
classes.description: Nested control handler classes used for iterating over controls to perform specific actions such as serialization, updating, or destruction.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes control information into a buffer, returning the number of bytes written.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates control states based on provided metadata and enable flag.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates control states based on stored settings.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of MessageUnit.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Initializes the MessageUnit with a specified path, configuration, and mode.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Initializes the MessageUnit with a specific instance ID, used in OOP components.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the MessageUnit, destroying controls and resetting resources.

methods.name: Default
methods.description: Determines if a control is enabled by default based on settings.

methods.name: Push
methods.description: Pushes a message of any type and its information to the buffer or directly outputs it.
